children: Homebuilder to host Grand Opening event for Grand Oaks of Callaway on Saturday, September 26
KEY TAKEAWAYS
New community coming soon:
Grand Oaks of Callaway is a new Century Complete community coming soon to Callaway, FL, offering a limited number of single-story homes from the upper $200s.
September Grand Opening:
Century Complete will host a Grand Opening event at Grand Oaks of Callaway on Saturday, September 26, from 12 to 3 p.m., featuring savings opportunities and a chance to get in early at the community.
Prior to the Grand Opening, an insider virtual event will be held Monday, September 14 from 5:30 to 6:
Attendees will learn about the home loan process, exclusive attendee-only savings opportunities, and how to prequalify with Century Complete's mortgage partner, Inspire Home Loans®.
Three single-story floor plans:
New homes at Grand Oaks of Callaway offer 1,416 to 1,773 square feet, 3 to 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and 2-car garages.
Minutes from Panama City Beach and Tyndall Air Force base:
Grand Oaks of Callaway is 20 minutes from the beautiful white, sandy beaches of Panama City Beach and just 10 minutes from Tyndall Air Force Base.
Designer features included:
Every home at Grand Oaks of Callaway comes standard with quartz countertops, LG® stainless-steel appliances, Kohler® water fixtures, white Shaker cabinetry and luxury vinyl plank flooring.
CALLAWAY, Fla., Sept. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (

)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—announced that new single-story homes are coming soon to Grand Oaks of Callaway, a new community from the Company's Century Complete brand, with a Grand Opening event set for Saturday, September 26. A virtual insider preview event will also be held on Monday, September 14. Featuring modern and affordable new homes from the upper $200s in a location less than five miles from Panama City, Grand Oaks of Callaway combines suburban ease with coastal charm.
Learn more, join the interest list, and RSVP for the Grand Opening at
Learn more and register for the insider virtual event on 9/14 at

"Grand Oaks of Callaway gives buyers an exciting opportunity to own an affordable, thoughtfully designed new home close to the coast," said Sal Aceves, Regional President of Operations at Century Complete. "With a limited number of homesites available, our Grand Opening event is the ideal time to find your best fit and take advantage of special savings opportunities."

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Question:
Where is Grand Oaks of Callaway located?
Answer:
Grand Oaks of Callaway is a new Century Complete community on Seneca Avenue in Callaway, FL, less than five miles from Panama City, with easy access to US-98 and major highways.
Question:
When is the Grand Opening?
Answer:
The Grand Opening at Grand Oaks of Callaway takes place Saturday, September 26, from 12 to 3 p.m. at Seneca Avenue, Callaway, FL 32404.
Question:
How much do new homes at Grand Oaks of Callaway cost?
Answer:
New homes at Grand Oaks of Callaway are coming soon from the upper $200s.
Question:
What floor plans are available at Grand Oaks of Callaway?
Answer:

Grand Oaks of Callaway offers three single-story plans: the Roanoke (1,773 square feet and 4 bedrooms), the Cabot (1,684 square feet and 4 bedrooms), and the Beaumont (1,416 square feet and 3 bedrooms). All three include 2 bathrooms and 2-car garages.
Question:
What features are included in the price at Grand Oaks of Callaway?
Answer:
Every home at Grand Oaks of Callaway comes standard with quartz countertops, LG® stainless-steel appliances, Kohler® water fixtures, white Shaker cabinetry, and luxury vinyl plank flooring.
Question:
What shopping and recreation are near Grand Oaks of Callaway?
Answer:

Grand Oaks of Callaway is close to everyday conveniences on Tyndall Parkway, including a Walmart Supercenter and Winn-Dixie, plus John B. Gore Park. Beaches, shopping and dining in Panama City and Panama City Beach are also just a short drive away.
Question:
Can I buy a home online?
Answer:

Yes. Century Complete's industry-first online homebuying lets homebuyers shop available homes and complete a purchase through the Buy Now process, while continuing to work with their local real estate agent of choice.
About Century Communities
Century Communities, Inc. (

) is one of the nation's largest homebuilders and a recognized industry leader in online home sales. Newsweek has named the Company one of America's Most Trustworthy Companies for four consecutive years. Through its Century Communities and Century Complete brands, Century's mission is to build attractive, high-quality homes at affordable prices to provide its valued customers with A HOME FOR EVERY DREAM®. Century is engaged in all aspects of homebuilding — including the acquisition, entitlement and development of land, along with the construction, innovative marketing and sale of quality homes designed to appeal to a wide range of homebuyers. The Company operates in 16 states and over 45 markets across the U.S., and also offers mortgage, title, insurance brokerage, and escrow services in select markets through its Inspire Home Loans, Parkway Title, IHL Home Insurance Agency, and IHL Escrow subsidiaries. To learn more about Century Communities, please visit www.centurycommunities.com.
